report:
VERDICT: FAIL (blocking cross-slice seam gaps; plans 01-06 and the RLS model are sound, 07 and 08 bind to symbols that do not exist and one fake-seam design violates the auth-fake isolation guard). All fixes are plan amendments, no redesign.

BLOCKING
B1. 07 imports symbols 03 does not export. 07 expects enqueueSaleEvents(tx,events), buildObligationUpsertedEvents({orgId,sale:SaleContext,obligations,state,voidReason,now}), buildSettlementRecordedEvent, buildSettlementReversedEvent, and a producer-gate.ts (isProducerFlowLive/registerProducerFlowGate). 03 actually exports enqueueEvent(tx,envelope), buildObligationUpsertedEnvelopes(orgId,source:{saleId,saleCode,clientName},obligations,meta:{newId,occurredAt}), buildSettlementEnvelope(orgId,row,meta) (single fn, null for finance). 03 derives state from row.status (no state or voidReason param; says voidReason omitted) and 03 files_modified has NO producer-gate.ts. Fix: amend 03 to own producer-gate.ts + an enqueueSaleEvents(tx,envelopes) wrapper and to accept an explicit state/voidReason, or amend 07 to the real 03 names and add producer-gate.ts to a slice's files_modified. Pick one contract and state it in both.
B2. The production gate is homeless. Nobody calls registerProducerFlowGate in real or fake mode (08 never mentions it; 07 says 08 does). Without it isProducerFlowLive stays false and no event is ever emitted at runtime (criteria 3-5 unmet outside tests). Fix: add to 08 (real: cached discoverAllActivations producer rows; fake: 06 activations where producer=app.fxl-sales).
B3. 08 imports symbols 02/03/04/06 do not export: buildIntegrationAuthorityConfig (02 has buildIntegrationConfig), createRealIntegrationAuthority (02 has three separate create* factories, no bundle, no discovery object), collectHeartbeatInputs (02 has only buildSalesHeartbeatBody; nobody builds HeartbeatInput from pairs/ConsumerMetrics, so the heartbeat loop input is homeless, criterion 9), createStandaloneIntegrationAdapter (03: createIntegrationPooledAdapter), createFinanceConsumer({adapter,ticketClient,discovery}) (04: buildFinanceConsumer(deps) returning IntegrationPullerOptions, with undefined type IntegrationDiscovery; 02 has async discoverContracts/discoverAllActivations/peerEndpointForRole/consumerPullPairs, no IntegrationDiscovery). 08 says adapt specifier only, but shapes differ (discovery object, heartbeat inputs), so it is not a rename. Also 04 needs an adapter whose tx exposes .drizzle (createConsumerAdapter in 04) while 08 gives the puller the 03 pooled adapter; the puller MUST get 04's createConsumerAdapter or hasDrizzleTx throws at first event.
B4. Fake-authority seam violates the isolation guard and is unowned. 08 dynamic-imports apps/api/src/auth/integration-authority-select.ts (resolveFakeIntegrationAuthority returning pairs); no slice creates it (not in 06 or 08 files_modified) and 06 says it will not touch apps/api/src. Verified scripts/__tests__/auth-fake-isolation.test.mjs: the literal import('@fxl-sales/auth-fake') is allowed ONLY inside apps/api/src/auth/select.ts (and the web seam); a new file naming it fails rule B. 06 exports getFakeIntegrationAuthority() from the root barrel (name matches the task brief) with no pairs. Fix: add select.ts (existing sanctioned seam) to 06 or 08 files_modified with an accessor that does the ONE import('@fxl-sales/auth-fake') and returns getFakeIntegrationAuthority() (+ activations as pairs); 08 calls that accessor via dynamic import. No subpath export (06 is right on that).
B5. Mount path bug. 05 defines router.get('/feed') and says mount at '/integration/v1'; 08 mounts app.route('/integration/v1/feed', router), giving /integration/v1/feed/feed. 09 asserts /integration/v1/feed. Fix 08 to mount at '/integration/v1'.
B6. recordedBy.app is wrong in 04 and 09. Package schema requires ^app\.[a-z0-9-]+$ and goldens use 'app.fxl-finance' / 'app.fxl-sales' (verified in dist/index.js). 04 sets FINANCE_APP_ID='fxl-finance' and rejects any event whose recordedBy.app !== that (every real Finance event becomes not_finance_origin); 09 builds finance payloads with app:'fxl-finance' (fails isSettlementRecordedV1) and asserts recordedBy.app==='fxl-sales' (03 emits 'app.fxl-sales'). Ref prefixes (fxl-finance:<uuid>) are correct as is; only the app-id is wrong. 04's own golden-example unit test would catch it, but the plan text must be fixed.

NOTES (executable if heeded)
N1 Anti-echo is not at exactly one choke point. 03 D6 (builder returns null for origin finance) AND 07 (origin==='manual' guard inside 04's applyBaixaTx) both guard, and 07 says no second guard. Also 04 says the writers stay emission-free and slice 07 hooks the manual WRAPPERS, while 07 places emission INSIDE applyBaixaTx/applyEstornoTx. Decide one: recommended emit in applyBaixaTx/applyEstornoTx gated origin==='manual' (catches every manual caller), keep builder null as documented defense in depth, and amend 04 so 'emission-free writers' does not contradict. 04/07 are in different waves (W3 then W4, 07 depends on 04) so the settlements.ts file edit is sequenced correctly; 07 must load the sale (code, client) inside the apply since apply only has saleId.
N2 RLS model is consistent in effect but 04 prose contradicts 01. 01 gives outbox/inbox/cursor BOTH tenant_isolation and admin_context policies; 04 says these tables are admin-only and 'blocker if 01 landed per-org predicate'. Functionally fine (puller on getAdminDb passes admin policy; it then calls setTenantContext on the tx for sales_ops writes; getAdminDb sets app.fxl_admin at connection level, verified client.ts:58; 03 producer enqueue rides withTenant app.current_org_id; 05 feed uses admin adapter and org from introspection). Delete 04's blocker wording. 01 seed uses set_config app.fxl_admin like 0024; hub_bff precedent verified in 0016.
N3 Fake boot authority cannot verify any peer ticket. 06 builds it with applicationId app.fxl-sales; the Sales->Finance activation has consumer=Finance, and per package semantics get() needs consumer===applicationId and verify() accepts only tickets that same instance minted. So in make dev-fake the mounted feed route can only ever 401. 09 correctly works around this with its own authority and a self-consumer activation, and drives the consumer through a simulated FetchFeedPage: 09 approach is SOUND. Record N3 in AUDIT.md. Also in fake mode 08 passes discovery:null so 04 financeFetchFeedPage has no Finance api_url; puller with non-empty pairs would error every tick. Decide explicitly (recommend empty pairs in fake boot, no new env).
N4 01 vs 06 both edit packages/auth-fake/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml (W1 vs W2, no overlap) but disagree: 01 puts fxl-contracts in dependencies, 06 says devDependencies. Make 06 a no-op (keep 01's, or move it in 06 and update 01's pin test consistently) to avoid a duplicate entry in both blocks.
N5 ledger.checkpoint has a builder (03) but no emitter, trigger or test in any slice; backfill of sales already won before an Activation goes live is also undecided. Criteria 3-5 do not require either, but log both as explicit non-goals in AUDIT.md. If checkpoint emission is ever added: 03 settlementFactFromRow uses settlementRef(row.id) => 'fxl-sales:' for finance-origin rows too, but Finance refs are 'fxl-finance:'; settlementDigest includes activeSettlementRefs so digests would diverge. Prefix by origin.
N6 duplicidade: 04 derives it (deriveSettlementAnomaly: not void, paid > amount, >1 active baixas) with no column; 09 asserts primarily via reduceSettlement (status paid, active=2, local=1, remote=1) plus an optional BIND. Consistent, but 09 should bind to deriveSettlementAnomaly (name is known: it is in 04) rather than grep, and assert it returns 'duplicidade'.
N7 deepLinkPath: 03 D1 emits /operacional/vendas/<saleId> because the v1 schema requires it (verified in plan against EVENT_TYPES); consistent with overview. Overview open decision closed. Fine.
N8 Env: no slice adds a new env var (02, 08 explicit; 08 reuses SALES_AUTH_FAKE). Prune low-water null fail-closed: fine (criterion 10 ok). 08 depends_on omits 06 (works only because 06 is in an earlier wave); add it. 08 mentions plan files 'not written yet' (stale). 09 header says siblings not authored (stale); it defers to BIND greps, which is why B1-B3 must be fixed upstream rather than left to the executor.
N9 Migration numbering 0025 is free (highest on disk is 0024_sales_ops_settlements). Plan 01 uses db:generate then renames and hand-appends RLS/seed; acceptable. Snapshot chain not verified beyond that.

PASS ITEMS
Coverage: all 13 criteria have an owner (1,2:01; 3-5:07 using 03 builders; 6,8,10: package via 08/04; 7:05; 9:02+08 (input assembly homeless, see B3); 11:06; 12:09; 13: wave gates). Producer path, consumer path, hub-client (ticket, introspection, discovery, heartbeat), fake-dev, wiring and E2E are all present. Testability: every slice names an oracle test path with concrete cases. Scope: no slice rebuilds PC2, settlements table, reducer or the requireAdmin gate; 04 refactors settlements.ts behavior-preservingly with existing oracles kept green. 06 correctly avoids apps/api/src and keeps the accessor on the root barrel per the isolation guard. server.ts (not index.ts) is correctly identified and 08 keeps its dynamic-import discipline; closeDb exists (client.ts:70).

Required before execution: fix B1-B6 in plans 03/04/07/08/09 (and 06 or 08 for the select.ts seam), re-run plan-check.
summary: FAIL: 6 blocking seam gaps (07/08 import symbols 03/02/04 do not export, gate+heartbeat-input+fake-seam homeless and fake seam violates auth-fake isolation, feed mounted at /feed/feed, recordedBy.app wrong in 04/09); RLS, coverage, testability, scope OK.
